会话直接建立在你与主机之间。: Sessions run directly between you and the host.
凭据保存在本机加密的凭据库中，不会上传到任何服务器。: Credentials stay in a local encrypted vault and are never uploaded.
连接过的桌面会显示在这里: Desktops you connect to appear here
选择一台主机，打开远程桌面。\n切换页面时，会话会继续保留。:
Pick a host to open its desktop.
Sessions keep running while you switch pages.
允许在本机与远程桌面之间复制文本: Copy text between this device and the remote desktop
按窗口大小缩放画面，保持宽高比: Scale the full desktop locally, preserving its aspect ratio and remote resolution.
主机密码经 AES-GCM 加密后写入本地凭据库，密钥由操作系统保管。删除主机时: Host passwords are sealed with AES-GCM in the local vault, and the key is held by the operating system. Deleting a host deletes its credentials.
OnRDP · 凭据仅在本机加密保存: OnRDP · credentials are stored encrypted on this device
连接使用 TLS 与网络级身份验证（NLA）。密码仅在本机加密保存。: Connections use TLS with Network Level Authentication. Passwords are stored encrypted on this device.
保存一台 Windows 主机，轻点即可连接。\n密码仅在本机加密保存。:
Save a Windows host and tap to connect.
Passwords stay encrypted on this device.
试试其他关键词，或切换到全部主机。: Try another keyword, or switch to all hosts.
远程桌面会话将关闭，未保存的工作可能丢失。: The remote session will close and unsaved work may be lost.
本机会移除主机及其登录凭据。: This device will remove the host and its credentials.
所有远程桌面会话将关闭。: Every remote desktop session will close.
请填写名称、地址和用户名: Fill in the name, address and user name
端口必须介于 1 和 65535 之间: The port must be between 1 and 65535
地址或用户名格式不正确: The address or user name is not valid
凭据库校验失败，未覆盖原文件: The vault failed authentication; the file was left untouched
随窗口调整分辨率: Resize the desktop with the window
流畅：最高 1280 × 720、16 位色；均衡：最高 1920 × 1080: Smooth: up to 1280 × 720, 16-bit color; Balanced: up to 1920 × 1080, 32-bit color; High: original resolution. Smooth and Balanced reduce desktop effects and also limit fullscreen resolution. Save and reconnect to apply.
